sources.title: AIC A 10/2025: implementation of Electronic Travel Authorization System
sources.officialityEvidence: SCAA's Aeronautical Information Management publishes this current AIC, which expressly implements directives of the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Immigration and Citizenship Agency.
sources.supportingExcerpt: With effect from 1 September 2025, all travelers holding foreign passports must possess a valid eTA.

sources.title: Visa information
sources.officialityEvidence: ICA's current public service page describes its federal entry-permit authority and current permit categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: An Immigration Permit is an official document ... authorizing official entry at the border crossings.

sources.title: AIP GEN 1.3: entry, transit and departure of passengers and crew
sources.officialityEvidence: SCAA publishes this current aeronautical-information entry page; it describes the online eTA procedure for arriving passengers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All arriving passengers are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) before their travel date.

sources.title: Services for Somali citizens abroad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
sources.officialityEvidence: The Federal MFA's current citizen-services page directly describes travel documents for Somali nationals returning to the country.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For Somali citizens needing to return to the country ... issuance of Temporary Emergency Travel Documents.

policies.title: Somali ordinary passport: citizen return access
policies.summary: The Federal MFA directly provides a temporary travel document for Somali citizens who need to return to Somalia even without a valid travel document. That direct citizen-return evidence supports the catalog citizenship classification.
conditions: The source supports return access for a Somali citizen, not a foreign-entry visa classification. Identity, citizenship verification, public-health, security and border-control requirements remain applicable.
It does not model refugee, emergency, diplomatic, official, service or other special-document treatment beyond the MFA's described citizen-return document.

policies.title: Foreign ordinary passports: mandatory electronic travel authorization
policies.summary: The SCAA AIC introduced eTA for foreign passports; the later current SCAA AIP states that all arriving passengers must obtain eTA and all visas are issued online. The later all-arrivals rule controls because it does not reproduce the earlier named exceptions.
conditions: Apply through the Electronic Travel Authorization System before travel and present a valid eTA; the current AIP says all arriving passengers must do so, and the AIC warns that failure where required may result in denial of boarding or entry.

ICA describes tourist visa as one of its entry-permit categories and says the permit may be a letter, stamp or sticker. The eTA rule does not establish stay duration, entry count, fee, work, residence, business-only, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, UNLP, multiple-visa, residence-permit or other special-document routes.

The earlier 3 September 2025 AIC names Rwanda/Malaysia as visa-free and eleven ordinary-passport nationalities as visa-on-arrival. The later current AIP, effective 27 November 2025, instead says all visas are issued online and all arriving passengers need eTA, without preserving an exception list. This temporal official-source conflict is resolved conservatively in favour of the later all-arrivals operational rule and requires recheck.

application.label: Somalia Electronic Travel Authorization System
steps: Apply for an eTA before travel through the official system identified in the SCAA AIC.
Meet the ICA's passport, health, criminal/immigration-history, departure-intention and financial requirements, and provide any requested medical or invitation evidence.
Present the valid eTA and passport or travel document at the Somali border; approval does not remove individual admissibility assessment.
